the pH-responsive multilayers functionalization on the surface of mesoporous silicas could enhance the therapeutic efficacy of anticancer drug delivery and minimize the side effects.

the design and fabrication of pH-responsive alg/chi multilayers functionalization on MSNs as an efficient nanocarrier system for the delivery of anticancer drugs.
the design, synthesis and characterization of mesoporous materials, and the application of the materials as drug delivery systems.
the design and development of biocompatible and pH-responsive nanocarrriers with improved therapeutic efficacy and reduced adverse effects.

the biocompatible alginate/chitosanan functionalized MSN-based nanocarriers are a promising platform to be developed as a pH-responsive drug-delivery system.

the biocompatible polyanions/polycations multilayered functionalized MSNs could be a promising candidate for the construction of efficient and biocompatible drug delivery systems.
